name: Thangam Subramanian
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
  - Status: NYHA II, weight 68 kg, waist 85 cm (>80 cm cutoff for women), bibasial crackles, SBP 118 mmHg
  - Plan: Continue sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; limit fluids 1.5 L/day, low‑salt diet; daily weight
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Idli with sambar, avoid pickle
  - Lunch: Wheat roti, dal, vegetable curry, no papad
  - Dinner: Light khichdi, curd, avoid fried snacks
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05 (repeat every 3 months while on dapagliflozin)
